_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_of_decedent.label: Estate Of Decedent
estate_of_decedent.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

declarant_name.label: Declarant Name
declarant_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

renunciation_nomination_actions.label: Renunciation Nomination Actions
renunciation_nomination_actions.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

nominate_pr_name.label: Nominate Pr Name
nominate_pr_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

concur_in_nominating_name.label: Concur In Nominating Name
concur_in_nominating_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

printed_or_typed_name.label: Printed Or Typed Name
printed_or_typed_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

address.label: Address
address.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
